payload.blocks: Phase 2 land, and through it phases 3, 6 and 7 of plan 261124-0004-heads-operate-without-owner
payload.headline: Commit phase 2's deny-rule fix by hand again, after rewording one doc line the commit check refuses?

parts.cause: This time git's error was kept: the pre-commit doc check refused docs/platform/run-supervisor/spec.md:377 because `fgos can-i` is not a verb of the ACTIVE release's command listing. This branch is what adds can-i, so a spec that names it can never pass until the release ships it. The first runner commit failed for the same reason.

options.does: Run the two commands at the end of phase-02-argv-window.md Lead notes from outside any head: one sed rewords `fgos can-i` to `khung can-i` on spec.md line 377, one git add + commit of exactly the 9 paths on branch heads-operate-without-owner/p02
options.gain: Keeps the passed fix; the commit runs every hook; the lead reviews and lands right after
options.harm: A second commit outside the runner, without runner provenance
options.label: Reword and commit by hand

options.does: Same git add + commit, skipping the hook, spec line unchanged
options.harm: Skips every pre-commit check, and the same doc finding comes back on the next spec commit
options.label: Commit with --no-verify

options.does: New worktree from main, rerun the main phase and the fix as units with a reworded spec
options.harm: Redoes about 45 minutes of worker time
options.label: Lead redoes it fresh

parts.recommendation: Reword and commit by hand: the doc line is the only blocker and a one-word reword makes the commit pass every hook.

scope.allows: One sed on docs/platform/run-supervisor/spec.md line 377 and one commit of exactly the 9 listed paths on branch heads-operate-without-owner/p02
scope.forbids: Pushing, landing on main, --no-verify (unless chosen), or touching any other file

parts.what: Fix unit c-29218-1795579848109 passed (it closes the --dir, protected-config-key and config-patch-file holes) but the runner's commit failed again, so 9 paths sit uncommitted in worktree 261124-0004-heads-operate-without-owner-p02. A rerun cannot commit them: the runner never commits paths that were already dirty before its round.
